applications.reason: The installed app is content-addressed by its Zero Install feed, which takes precedence over the WinGet fallback.
Use the executable for installed state and normalize the MSI build suffix to the public release version.
Battle.net owns its update lifecycle through Blizzard's installed updater; the WinGet fallback is blocked.
Brave Origin keeps its installed native update channel; the WinGet fallback cannot replace its channel.

TechSmith's installed registry version truncates the calendar year (e.g. 26.3.1 for release 2026.3.1) while the Chocolatey community package publishes the full year; naive comparison falsely reports every current install as outdated.
